_instructions: THE ONE HUMAN STEP. Create payment links, paste them below, commit, push. Done.

Option A (recommended, ~10 min): gumroad.com -> New product -> type 'Digital product' -> upload the zip from products/dist/ -> set the price -> copy the short link (e.g. https://yourname.gumroad.com/l/xxxx).
Option B: dashboard.stripe.com -> Payment Links -> New. Note: with Stripe you must also deliver the file; Gumroad handles delivery for you, which is why it's recommended for zero-touch operation.
Leave a value as null to keep that product in pre-launch mode. The storefront reads this file at page load.
